subject: Rsubread throws "Cannot open file" and "Cannot open connection" error

messages.author: 5bb3db725cc5d6fa
messages.subject: Rsubread throws "Cannot open file" and "Cannot open connection" error
parts:
Hi,

I am having a problem with Rsubread in a cluster setting on a shared NFS file system (with delays, which could potentially be the problem?). After a short while, I am receiving the following message:

WARN [2018-08-02 11:26:39] cannot open file './.Rsubread_featureCounts_pid5809': No such file or directory

ERROR [2018-08-02 11:26:39] cannot open the connection


Then things crash. I am using BiocParallel to run a loop in parallel, each iteration of which calls feaureCounts from within R. in parallel. 

I am really hoping this issue can be solved, I redesigned my pipeline to move from the Subread package and featureCounts to an R-only solution but now it appears I cannot use it properly :(.

Thanks,
Christian

messages.author: 6569f7247d312021
messages.subject: Re: Rsubread throws "Cannot open file" and "Cannot open connection" error
parts:
Hi Christian,

Are you using the latest version of Rsubread? The latest version is 1.30.5.

The error message might be a caused by an issue in old versions of Rsubread.

Regards,

Wei

messages.author: 5bb3db725cc5d6fa
messages.subject: Re: Rsubread throws "Cannot open file" and "Cannot open connection" error
parts:
I am using 1.28.1, this is the most recent version that biocLite gives. Do you think the issue could be this? 

Thanks!

messages.author: 6569f7247d312021
messages.subject: Re: Rsubread throws "Cannot open file" and "Cannot open connection" error
parts:
You need update your R to the latest version first then you can run biocLite() to install the latest version of Rsubread. Your question involves multiple Bioc packages so it is probably better to post it to Bioc support site:

https://support.bioconductor.org/

Cheers,

Wei
